report.source_text: He was started on pancreatic enzyme replacement therapy (PERT) with 2 tablets of lipase-protease-amylase (24 000–76 000–120 000 units) by mouth 3 times a day with meals. His diarrhea improved 2 months after initiation of PERT, allowing him to regain weight to his previous baseline while reducing his caloric intake to 1800 to 2000 calories per day.

clinician.trajectory_summary: A 71-year-old man with significant history of Roux-en-Y bypass and type 2 diabetes presented with new-onset severe diarrhea, 41-kg weight loss, greasy stools, and foul-smelling gas. Initial testing revealed a fecal elastase <40 μg/g and massive steatorrhea (277 g/24h), confirming severe pancreatic exocrine insufficiency. Physical exam showed mild muscle weakness and peripheral edema consistent with malnutrition. After initiation of pancreatic enzyme replacement therapy, the patient had significant symptom improvement and weight regain within two months.
